tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Workflow status describes your work. Run labels describe the agent.
tasks.createMultipleReason: Creating several tasks at once is planned.

query.sortNote: Sorting never changes the run queue.

loadError.title: Tasks cannot be read
loadError.body: Reading the task list from the project database failed. {{reason}} No task was changed. The list appears once it can be read.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.detail: Describe what agents should build as a task. Drafts can be saved before every detail is known.

noMatches.title: No tasks in this tab match the search or pipeline filter.

inTab.one: {{tab}} has {{count}} task. Search looks at titles, keys and briefs.
inTab.other: {{tab}} has {{count}} tasks. Search looks at titles, keys and briefs.

emptyTab.title: No tasks in this tab.
emptyTab.detail: A task shows here once its workflow status is {{tab}}.

emptyNeedsYou.detail: A task shows here while its run waits for an answer, an approval or a decision.

outsideTasks.body: This list shows tasks only. The Needs you panel lists everything that waits for you.

shared.removedTitle: You're no longer a member of {{project}} on {{server}}
shared.removedBody: {{server}} answered at {{time}} that you aren't in {{project}} any more. This computer keeps {{key}}'s {{count}} tasks as they were then, read-only. Runs already going here finish; none can start. Make {{project}} local to keep working here, or ask an owner, {{owners}}, to add you again.

title.one: 1 task stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}
title.other: {{count}} tasks stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}

notShared.body: {{keys}} weren't ticked on {{day}}. They keep their key, runs, conversations and memory here, read-only and out of the shared list. Share task on a task's page uploads it to {{server}} with the next {{key}} number.

footer.one: 1 Not shared task · on this computer only
footer.other: {{count}} Not shared tasks · on this computer only

foundByFormer.one: {{count}} task · found by its key before joining
foundByFormer.other: {{count}} tasks · found by their keys before joining

notShared.foundOne: {{key}} {{title}} stayed on this computer as Not shared.
notShared.foundMany: {{count}} tasks that match stayed on this computer as Not shared.
